::: {#exr-shape-rule}

#### Which of these products are defined?

Let $A$ be $4 \times 3$, let $B$ be $3 \times 2$, and let $\vec x \in \mathbb{R}^3$.
For each expression, say whether it is defined,
and if so give the shape of the result:

1.  $AB$
2.  $BA$
3.  $A \vec x$
4.  $\vec x^\top \vec x$
5.  $\vec x \vec x^\top$

:::
